annotations.title: Get the values of a company over time

description: The values of one company over time: items of its statements and ratios together (measures: revenue, net_income, total_assets, cfo, corp.operating_margin, roic), a whole statement (statement: income_statement, balance_sheet, cash_flow) or a category of ratios. frequency is quarterly, annual, ttm (ratios over the last 4 quarters) or quarter_end; from and to are fiscal periods or ISO dates; at gives the snapshot that was the latest on a date. Each value comes with its unit, method and source documents, a ratio with the documents of the figures it is computed from. A page holds the latest periods and next gives the earlier ones; not_included names what is left out, such as the quarters of a company that reports fiscal years only.

at.description: an ISO date: the snapshot that was the latest on that date, in place of the latest snapshot

category.description: every ratio of one category, for example Credit metrics or Profitability

compact.description: values and units only, without definitions, methods and documents

company.description: the company of a search result (apple), or a ticker or CIK

cursor.description: the next of an earlier answer, for the next page of the same call

frequency.description: default: quarters where the company reports them, ttm for ratios

from.description: first period: a fiscal year (2024), a fiscal quarter (FY2024 Q2) or an ISO date

measures.description: item keys, item labels or ratio ids or short names

to.description: last period, in the same forms

name: get_series
title: Get the values of a company over time
